description.zh: 需要解绑的输出媒体Bucket名称，可以通过**MPS控制台** > **工作流管理** > **媒体Bucket**获取，或通过**OSS控制台** > **我的访问路径**获取。
description.en: The name of the output media bucket to detach. You can find it in the **MPS console** > **Workflow Management** > **Media Buckets**, or in the **OSS console** > **My Access Paths**.

descriptions.zh:
本接口通过媒体Bucket名称指定需要解绑的输出媒体Bucket。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
This API operation detaches the specified output media bucket by its bucket name.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API operation is 100 per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this operation only as needed. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
